units.source_text: 啰喀是个经常被拿来跟库拉巴喀相提并论的音乐家。

en.t: Roka was a musician often mentioned in the same breath as Kurabaka.

units.source_text: 不过他不是超人俱乐部的会员，我从未跟他讲过话。

en.t: But he was not a member of the Superman Club, and I had never spoken with him.

units.source_text: 不过我看到过很多他的照片：嘴巴翘起来，相貌异于常人。

en.t: However, I had seen many photographs of him: his mouth jutted out, and his appearance was unlike that of ordinary people.
